dedupe_keys.name: data in experimental stand alone microgrid

description: The PIMENT Laboratory releases recordings from its first experimental standalone microgrid at Roche Plate in Mafate, Réunion. Zenodo lists public compressed archives and a README under CC BY 4.0. The README describes meteorological variables, PV production and electrical state, battery voltage and current, and demand of three houses, with units for irradiance, weather and plant output. These series can calibrate off-grid solar, battery and household-demand simulations in an isolated community. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this Roche Plate testbed. A limitation is that the public README does not state a complete observation period, sampling interval, missing-data policy or battery capacity. Three households are not a representative island-wide demand sample, and the microgrid’s operation should not be equated with hypothetical expansion to all of Mafate. The .7z files were not downloaded, so file-row counts and alignment across sensors were not verified. No storage or power balance was reproduced.
